editorial_note: Imported V15 data; existing question-level research/editorial flags are preserved, not independently recertified.

q1.prompt: Name a video game that sold at least 14,640,000 copies on one gaming platform.
q1.metric: Historical VGChartz platform-level sales estimates, copies, rounded to 10,000; partial import of documented games
q1.metric_provenance: Historical VGChartz platform sales estimates from partial 2020 snapshot. Each listed title is assigned the highest available listed platform observation; other platforms may be missing. Not an all-game or current-to-2026 sales census.

measurement.numeric_rule: Maximum documented worldwide copies on a single platform among locally imported verified VGChartz records; missing platform figures are not presumed zero.

answer_scope.entity_scope: Top ranked games transcribed from a VGChartz-based historical platform sales export, de-duplicated to each title’s highest listed platform. Only sampled portion imported.

q1.scoring_policy: Only documented eligible entities; wrong side and outside scoring window 0; no fabricated measurements.
